story.title: From Our Kitchen in Uttar Pradesh
content: We started Hariram to bring back the taste of grandmother's recipes. In a world of mass-manufactured snacks, we chose the slower path.

Every batch is made in our home kitchen in Uttar Pradesh, ensuring the authentic taste of tradition. We use the same spices our family has used for generations—ground fresh, roasted slow, and mixed with love.

image.alt: Traditional Indian kitchen setting with spices and brass utensils

kitchen.title: No Factories. Just Our Kitchen.
kitchen.description: Every batch is prepared in small quantities to ensure freshness. We taste-test everything. If it's not good enough for our family, it doesn't go into your jar.
